controls.procedure: Parse normative issue list items and compare them independently against the closed requirement set.
controls.expected: All canonical normative list items remain represented.
controls.observed: All twelve current canonical obligations are represented on the material head.

controls.procedure: Before tree construction compute each local Git blob SHA and compare it with the GitHub create-blob SHA returned for the exact bytes.
controls.expected: Publication stops before tree creation if any remote blob differs from the local bytes.
controls.observed: The remediation publication protocol requires exact local/remote Git blob SHA equality for every handoff file on the material head.

controls.procedure: Pack large audit JSON with the canonical packer, enforce ASCII strict Base64 parts, and load it through audit_artifact_io before certificate generation.
controls.expected: Every manifest and part reconstructs the exact logical JSON with matching encoded and decoded hashes.
controls.observed: The regenerated sharded artifacts are validated by the canonical strict loader before publication on the unchanged material head.

retired_controls.reason: Historical foreign-target control retained for cumulative lineage.
retired_controls.procedure: Compare each historical control target with the current work-item before allowing the retired control to satisfy any current requirement or risk-family gate.
retired_controls.expected: A control from a different delivery target remains retired and cannot count as current evidence.
retired_controls.observed: The historical control is retained only for cumulative lineage and is not used to satisfy any current view-model boundary requirement.
